summary: The audio group holds 239 rows: 238 regular files and one symbolic link, spread over product_a (51), system_a (111), system_ext_a (12) and vendor_a (65). It contains the Android audio framework (audioserver binary, AudioFlinger and AudioPolicy libraries, AAudio, AIDL client stubs, and HIDL audio interface libraries for versions 4.0 to 7.0), the vendor HAL service and HAL modules (a primary HAL for the anorak platform linked against vendor.qti PAL and AGM components, plus generic primary, USB, remote-submix and A2DP modules), an effects stack of 26 AELI effect libraries (13 per lib directory, plus effects factory and HAL impl libraries), policy, effects, IO-profile and mixer-path configuration files, a system_ext audiotapper service with latency and capture test tools, and 49 Vorbis-in-Ogg UI, alarm, notification and ringtone clips. Init and SELinux references are present for audioserver (system init file, process and service labels), the vendor HAL service (two init definitions of the same service name, HAL labels), the audiotapper pair (disabled services with property triggers and SELinux types), and the Qualcomm ADSP RPC daemon. The roles file has a header and 239 data rows.
